items.description: Bookbound is a sci-fi adventure story about a boy who hates reading until a mysterious book takes him on an interdimensional journey through crumbling worlds. Guided by a cosmic stranger, Danko must save the universe. Bookbound is a genre-shifting adventure where every level offers a fresh perspective — both visually and mechanically. One world plays like a classic platformer, the next as a third-person narrative journey, and another plunges you into first-person exploration, and more... This constant evolution mirrors the power of a Danko (protagonist) imagination.Ancient Beacons, once created by long-lost civilizations to hold reality together, are shutting down — and with them, entire worlds are collapsing into nothingness.Only Danko, with the power of his imagination and pure heart, can reignite the Beacons and restore balance. To do so, he must journey across fractured worlds — each with its own rules, dangers, and visual language. Prepare to dive into a game where every new level means new mechanics, new settings, new challenges, and new adventures.You’ll experience space flights, turn-based battles, puzzle solving, and much more.From third-person to platformer, from first-person to top-down — in Bookbound, every step opens a new way to play.Save the universe with Danko. items.description: Tiny Wizard Tavern is a cozy fantasy management game about running a magical roadside tavern in a medieval world.Buy food, ale, and herbs in the morning, prepare for the evening rush, and welcome a colorful mix of travelers: mages, merchants, mercenaries, bards, and pilgrims. Each guest has their own needs, mood, and traits, so every evening becomes a small story.Keep your tavern supplied, protect your reputation, and make difficult choices when resources run low. Offer a discount to calm an impatient guest, invest in upgrades, and decide what kind of tavern you want to build: a warm refuge for travelers, a lively gathering place, or a strange magical stop on the road.The world outside your door is never quiet. Unexpected events can change the flow of the game: wealthy caravans, moonlit markets, tavern brawls, guild attention, hungry rats, and even a dragon drawn by the scent of gold.Features:- Simple and readable tavern management loop- Fantasy guests with different traits and behavior- Magical events that affect each playthrough- Tavern upgrades and strategic choices- Cozy illustrated style with a warm medieval fantasy atmosphereBuild your name, survive the season, and turn a small tavern into a place travelers will never forget. items.description: Climb to the Peak for Your Son! Samuel is an ordinary lumberjack seeking peace deep within the Bright Forest. His only wish is to teach his son, Jonah, the family trade. However, an ancient terror known as Claw turns this ordinary day into a bloody nightmare. Defeated by the savage attack, Samuel wakes up to find his son missing and his memory of the event wiped clean.Axe and Claw is a father's journey woven with guilt, love, and vengeance. Grab your trusty axe, fill in the blanks in your memory, and tear through everything that stands in your way to Claw's peak!Features:A Personal and Gripping Story: A dramatic narrative that lets you deeply feel the bond between Samuel and Jonah.Trail of Lost Memories: You don't remember what happened. Piece together the clues as you climb and uncover the terrifying truth.A Ruthless Ascent: A breathtaking vertical adventure starting from the peaceful Bright Forest to Claw's treacherous, freezing peak.Hardcore and Technical Gameplay: Master your trusty axe not just to chop wood, but to brutally execute Claw's minions and overcome obstacles.Atmospheric Pixel-Art: A visually stunning pixel-art world, meticulously crafted from the tranquility of the forest to the horrors of the summit. items.description: Welcome to Horse Spirit Valley──────────────────────────────Step into a soft, sunlit fantasy where the rhythm is simple: ride, sparkle, dress up your mount, and unlock new pastures when you’re ready for the next view. No rush—just you, the trail, and a pocket full of dreams.🐎 Ride & explore────────────────────• Third-person horseback adventure across handcrafted 3D valleys—grass, light, and space to breathe.• Every outing has a honest goal on the HUD: collect every diamond tucked into the world.• Nail the set and the UI celebrates a full clear—a small victory lap for collectors who love a tidy map.💎 Diamonds that work for you──────────────────────────────────• Gems you pick up stick with you between sessions—your balance is always on screen.• Sink savings into new environments beyond your starter pasture, or into cosmetic unlocks for your horse.• Low on glitter? The interface tells you straight—no opaque economy tricks.🦄 Make the horse unmistakably yours──────────────────────────────────────────• Deep dressing room: size, coat, mane style & tint, saddle & reins, armor look & color, horn shape & color.• Preview everything in the customization hub, save a look you adore, and spend diamonds when a premium style calls your name.🗺️ Pastures waiting past the horizon──────────────────────────────────────────• The map picker shows art, title, and price—play what you own or buy the next dreamscape with saved diamonds.• Your first world is ready on day one; the rest open when you decide the valley has earned another stamp in your passport.🌍 Play your way────────────────────• Tweak resolution, dial real-time shadows for performance, flip music—this is your session.• A shuffled soundtrack keeps menus and rides from feeling samey; fairy-tale calm follows you scene to scene.🎮 Controls that respect the couch──────────────────────────────────────• Keyboard & mouse feel natural; gamepad users get menus that behave.• Pause, adjust, or bounce to the main menu when life interrupts the ride—progress stays where you left it.🏆 Steam, quietly cheering you on────────────────────────────────────────• Achievements reward first rides, diamond milestones, full clears, visiting every map, saving looks, shopping, and coming back for more.✨ Who it’s for──────────────────Horse Spirit Valley is a low-stress, high-satisfaction pocket of magic: wander, shimmer, restyle, unlock, repeat.
